evidence: Has the Wallet label and updates CWallet::FillPSBT in DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan to populate PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB resolves long-standing compatibility failures with external hardware signers and coordinators. As documented in #27583, stateless signers like BitBox02 and Trezor reject or misinterpret multisig PSBTs missing this BIP 174 field, forcing external coordinator workarounds.
